headline: Emami Realty National Head of Sales resigns
summary: Emami Realty has announced the resignation of Tarun Kanti Mukherjee, who served as the National Head of Sales & Marketing. His departure will take effect on January 11, 2027. The company made this regulatory filing to the stock exchange regarding the senior management change. Routine sales leadership departures in small-cap real estate firms have minimal direct impact on retail portfolios.
why_it_matters: Routine management exit with minimal retail impact.

headline: Emami Realty releases minutes from September AGM
hook: Emami Realty concludes annual shareholder meeting
summary: Emami Realty Limited has filed the official minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, with the NSE. The filing provides a formal record of the proceedings and resolutions passed during the meeting. This is a routine compliance disclosure required for all listed entities.
